point_estimate_method: Hajek ratio of inverse union-inclusion probabilities; unique exact pairs
sampling_design: independent simple random sampling without replacement within source/surrogate/recipe strata, followed by pair deduplication; pi = 1 - product(1 - n_h/N_h)
limitations: Unreviewed pairs, incomplete reviews, uncertain labels and disagreements remain unresolved.
Finite-population bounds use observed labels only. Weighted sample shares and a fully resolved sample point estimate carry sampling uncertainty; no design-based confidence interval is supplied.
The sample supports overall pair review preparation. It does not establish precise validity rates for 50 surrogate/recipe cells or a CKA-validity association.
Distinct registered reviewer identities and independence attestations are checked mechanically; a human coordinator must enforce separate review before discussion.
Meaning, injection intent and the original injection label require human judgment. Edit distances provide no semantic-validity label.
